classification: preregistered fixed-factor risk-budget experiment on the reproducible R40 snapshot; not a new alpha search
decision_rule: Select only a dynamic overlay that passes G1-G5; report G6 as an incrementality gate. If none pass, record negative knowledge and do not tune the lookback, target, bounds, or monthly cost after seeing results.
execution_boundary: Use only a temporary copy of data/research/r40_engine_data. Do not write production data, call providers, alter R102 source, or search additional parameters.

gates.G1_execution: all runs complete without error and produce non-empty equity curves
gates.G2_drawdown: at least one dynamic overlay has full-period MDD >= -25%
gates.G3_recent: same passing overlay has recent mean return >0 and at least 4/5 positive fresh-start phases
gates.G4_return: same overlay has full-period annualized return >=5% and Sharpe >=0.35, with 10/10 long-period phases positive
gates.G5_cost: same overlay has positive full-period 3x return and MDD >= -30%
gates.G6_control: dynamic overlay must beat fixed50 on either MDD by >=5pp or Sharpe by >=0.05; otherwise record no incremental timing value

fixed50.role: control for whether dynamic timing adds value

question: Can a simple 60-day volatility target or fixed cash allocation reduce the R102 maximum drawdown below the prior unacceptable level while retaining enough return and recent stability?
